name: Firecrawl Student Program
benefit: One-time grant of 10,000 Firecrawl API credits for web crawling and data extraction.
eligibility: Currently enrolled students with a valid academic email address at a college, university or accredited program.

restrictions: Credits are intended for educational or personal projects; use the official student coupon workflow. Check provider terms for expiration and usage restrictions.
